Overview & City Profile

Cologny (Cologny (BFS 6617)) is a municipality in Geneva, Canton of Geneva (coordinates 46.2182°N, 6.185°E; population 5,598). Visitors use Cologny as a base to explore Canton of Geneva's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Filets de perche, Longeole sausage, Cardons épineux genevois.

Within Canton of Geneva Region (Geneva region), Cologny (Cologny (BFS 6617)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in canton of geneva region. Travelers exploring Canton of Geneva often combine a stop in Cologny with regional highlights such as Jet d'Eau & Lake Geneva harbor, Vieille Ville & St. Pierre Cathedral, Palais des Nations & CERN Science Gateway, Carouge bohemian quarter.

Getting to Cologny & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Geneva Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Geneva Airport (GVA) is 7 minutes by free train from Genève-Cornavin station; TGV Lyria to Paris.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Canton of Geneva Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Geneva with Cologny. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Canton of Geneva have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Cologny en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Cologny are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Canton of Geneva can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Switzerland Guide.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Canton of Geneva: May–Oct.

Regional highlights across Canton of Geneva Region that pair well with a visit to Cologny include: Jet d'Eau & Lake Geneva harbor, Vieille Ville & St. Pierre Cathedral, Palais des Nations & CERN Science Gateway, Carouge bohemian quarter.

Practical Travel Tips for Cologny

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Cologny (or at Geneva Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Cologny accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Cologny (Cologny (BFS 6617)) located in Switzerland?

Cologny (Cologny (BFS 6617)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Canton of Geneva Region in the Geneva region of Switzerland (coordinates: 46.2182°N, 6.185°E). It has a population of approximately 5,598 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Cologny by train?

Most visitors reach Cologny via the main prefectural gateway of Geneva Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Geneva Airport (GVA) is 7 minutes by free train from Genève-Cornavin station; TGV Lyria to Paris. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Cologny. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Cologny and Canton of Geneva known for?

In Cologny and across Canton of Geneva Region, top local dishes include Filets de perche, Longeole sausage, Cardons épineux genevois, as well as Artisanal Swiss watchmakers' cafés & chocolatiers. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Cologny?

Best time to visit Canton of Geneva: May–Oct. Check our Switzerland Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
